# Instructions for Copilot: Riverside Diner menu and reviews

<!-- TEAM: finish every part marked TEAM together in Session 9. Use facts from the owner's answer card only. -->

## About this project
A phone friendly menu page, a how to change a menu item note, and a checked summary of reviews for a breakfast and lunch diner.
This is a practice project for a fictional business.

## How to build
- Plain HTML and CSS only for pages. No frameworks, no build tools.
- One page per file. Mobile first: every page must read well on a phone.
- Only change the file I name in my prompt. Ask before touching any other file.
- Explain each change in plain words.

## Working with the data files
- Never change the files in data/raw/ or data/. Write results to a new file.
- To clean or count data, write one small Python script in scripts/, explain what it does, and wait for me before running it.
- List every change you make. Never delete a row without telling me which row and why.
- Never paste rows of data into chat. Describe the columns instead.

- Never invent facts, prices, numbers or names that are not in the data files or this file.
